offering_description.value: Operates small-ship expedition cruises and land-based adventure trips to remote and nature-focused destinations, sold to leisure travelers and delivered with naturalists, guides and onboard staff.

primary_services.value: expedition cruises; land adventure tours; guided shore excursions; group charters

customer_segment.value: B2C: affluent leisure travelers, couples, families and retirees booking expedition trips

end_markets.value: travel and tourism; conservation and education; hospitality

revenue_model.value: service fees: trip fares for expedition cruises and land tours, including onboard services and guiding

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells and delivers guided travel experiences to individual travelers; asset operator: owns and runs a fleet of expedition ships and operates the trips, sold to leisure travelers

geography_served.value: global: expeditions to polar regions, Galapagos, Latin America, Africa, Asia, Europe and other remote destinations worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: expedition cruises, land adventure tours and travel partnerships sharing the same guests and destinations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: booking through the company website and its own sales staff; agents / brokers: independent travel advisors who book trips for clients; partners / resellers: travel partners and affinity programs that sell trips to their members
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: maritime safety, vessel and environmental rules, port access and passenger protection rules for cruise operations
